exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "Must / Have to".

options.text: A とか B とか
A は B ほど～ありません
A は B ほど～ない

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! ～なければ ならない matches "Must / Have to".
exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct pattern is ～なければ ならない.
exercises.explanation: Expresses obligation; used to say someone must or has to do something.
